issue_request: FHIR-29271 was a Published FHIR-core/FHIR-I change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking to replace confusing Bundle reference-resolution prose with a clearer algorithm for resolving references in Bundles.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit e084181ce7efd960c27096be172fcc0d0e845a81 on 2022-09-04, which rewrote source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml and updated source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml for FHIR-29271 and FHIR-31422.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes and the Zulip review thread show that the working group narrowed the draft algorithm before approval by removing Reference.identifier resolution, in-bundle conditional-reference resolution, relative references to UUIDs, and missing-fullUrl assumptions. FHIR-31422 clarified arbitrary URI schemes and is already represented on the combined branch. Later issues such as FHIR-27813, FHIR-43101, and FHIR-43106 refine adjacent fullUrl wording but do not reverse the FHIR-29271 algorithm.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml already contains the clarified URN, absolute URL, RESTful-base relative reference, transaction conditional reference, contained-resource, missing-fullUrl, and ambiguity guidance. source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml also retains the related fullUrl URI constraints.
